name: 24801 · Welch, WV
findings: ZIP 24801 (Welch) has 26 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (23%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 5 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 24801 (Welch) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
50% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
